kinds.script: Hi, I have been a customer for a while and I am reviewing my bills. I can get a similar plan elsewhere for less. What can you do on my monthly price, or is there a cheaper plan that keeps what I use?

Hi, I am looking at my internet bill. New customers are offered a lower price than I pay, and other providers here are cheaper. Can you match a new-customer rate or move me to a plan that costs less? If not, please connect me with the retention team.
Hi, I am thinking of cancelling TV service because of the price. Before I do, what promotions or smaller packages can you offer me?

Hi, I am shopping my car insurance. Can you check every discount I qualify for (safe driver, bundling, paying in full, low mileage, autopay) and quote a higher deductible? I have a quote from another company for less.
Hi, I am reviewing my policy. Can you check for discounts (bundling, security system, claims-free, paying in full) and tell me what a higher deductible would save?
Hi, I am thinking of cancelling my membership because of the cost. Is there a lower rate, an off-peak plan or a freeze option you can offer?
